sourceChecks.text: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of the LORD; but I hate him, for he never prophesies good concerning me, but always evil. He is Micaiah the son of Imla.” Jehoshaphat said, “Don’t let the king say so.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名があり、指定の親子・役割・所属をこの節の文脈に限定して確認。

sourceChecks.text: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, “Get Micaiah the son of Imla quickly.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名があり、指定の親子・役割・所属をこの節の文脈に限定して確認。

sourceChecks.text: The messenger who went to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, “Behold, the words of the prophets declare good to the king with one mouth. Let your word therefore, please be like one of theirs, and speak good.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名があり、指定の親子・役割・所属をこの節の文脈に限定して確認。

sourceChecks.text: Micaiah said, “As the LORD lives, I will say what my God says.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名があり、指定の親子・役割・所属をこの節の文脈に限定して確認。

sourceChecks.text: When he had come to the king, the king said to him, “Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall I forbear?” He said, “Go up, and prosper. They shall be delivered into your hand.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名があり、指定の親子・役割・所属をこの節の文脈に限定して確認。

sourceChecks.text: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and struck Micaiah on the cheek, and said, “Which way did the LORD’s Spirit go from me to speak to you?”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名があり、指定の親子・役割・所属をこの節の文脈に限定して確認。

sourceChecks.text: Micaiah said, “Behold, you shall see on that day, when you go into an inner room to hide yourself.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名があり、指定の親子・役割・所属をこの節の文脈に限定して確認。

sourceChecks.text: The king of Israel said, “Take Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king’s son;
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名があり、指定の親子・役割・所属をこの節の文脈に限定して確認。

sourceChecks.text: Micaiah said, “If you return at all in peace, the LORD has not spoken by me.” He said, “Listen, you people, all of you!”
